Sparkling Tones for desktop, part one: overview and connecting.
Switch on your Spark, open Sparkling Tones on your computer, and click "Connect".
The app reads the eight presets stored in the amp by itself, and shows the one that's playing.
The arrows next to the name step through the amp's slots, one click at a time.
On the right is your whole library. Click a preset, and it plays on the amp straight away.
At the bottom, the whole signal chain, always in view: every pedal and the amp, in order.
Sparkling Tones: free, for Windows and in your browser. Next: the editor.
